▌ ✦ The gate has four checks (Policy 3):                                                                             ▕▄▖
▌                                                                                                                    ▕ ▌
▌   1. Right zone worker authored                                                                                    ▕ ▌
▌   2. Invariants hold                                                                                               ▕ ▌
▌                                                                                                                    ▕ ▌
▌   ▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄ ▕ ▌
▌    func Gate(w *Workspace) Verdict {                                                                               ▕ ▌
▌        return w.Check(4)                                                                                           ▕ ▌
▌    }                                                                                                               ▕ ▌
